title: Dakar mobility and services connect with a separately bounded wind account
summary: Dakar BRT, Taïba N’Diaye and the Dakar administrative region separate operating assets from integration work, development proposals and targeted services. Eligibility reaches 100 projects and 69 places; complete-content and release gates remain separate.
evidence_note: Fifteen primary sources inspected November 22: twelve HTML bodies or segments, two official indexed excerpts and one extracted PDF narrative. Seven French and eight English records retain exact access limits and reporting periods. Unverified PDF tables, population figures and development outcomes are excluded.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
